podcast.body: A song from Millie Jackson's 1974 album "Cocktop," curiously titled "The Rap." In this track, she recites the lyrics with rhyme, which was a more advanced and interesting approach compared to earlier narrative styles, showing an evolution towards modern rap. "curiosamente esta canción se llama de rap."

srcs.episode: El RAP antes del RAP (los primeros años del rap)
